candidates.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Enformion
candidates.description: About Enformion Enformion is a dynamic powerhouse in data intelligence and AI-powered identity verification. We deliver next-generation fraud prevention, risk management, and seamless onboarding solutions that foster ironclad trust between digital marketplaces, merchants, and consumers. By leveraging our massive data repositories and advanced behavioral analysis, we provide continuous monitoring for emerging risk indicators. In a digital world where security and trust are everything, Enformion is at the forefront of the industry—and we are growing fast. Job Purpose Enformion provides identity and contact data to enterprise clients through APIs, and supports a network of consumer-facing websites built on that data. Enformion is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to keep these sites and APIs available, fast, and protected from abusive traffic. This role sits where reliability and security meet. The SRE will work closely with software engineering, information security, and legal/compliance to build and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure. The role covers monitoring, resolving complex technical issues, and automating solutions to recurring problems, and it plays a central part in optimizing Enformion platforms and infrastructure. Salary - $150K-$165K Responsibilities Reliability and monitoring Monitor availability, latency, and error rates across Enformion APIs.
